_note: GAME-04 stage 1 and GAME-05: the shield. Every number the shield is tuned by. look is in metres and camera space (a child of the camera): lowered hangs low left, raised sits across the view; diameter is the disc's. block is the hold-to-block: raiseTime seconds to raise, frontArcDeg the arc of cover in front of the view, damageShare the part of an attack's damage that still lands inside it, walkShare the walk-speed multiplier, kick the view kick in radians decaying over kickTime. throw is press fire while raised: speed m/s, damage per Foamer hit, stun the stagger time in seconds (0 reuses the Foamer's own stagger.time), bounces extra Foamers after the first, range and homeRange metres, returnSpeed on the way back, carveRadius metres of voxel cover with debris capped at debrisMax. cooldown is the seconds after a catch before the disc can be thrown again. parry (GAME-04 stage 2) turns a parryable ball back: raise the shield within window seconds of the hit, at most, to parry instead of block (raising later only blocks); the parried ball leaves at speedShare times its incoming horizontal speed, steered at the thrower's chest for steerSec seconds, and does damage on the hit (stagger 0 reuses the Foamer's own stagger.time); kick the view kick in radians decaying over kickTime; hitStop seconds of world slow, at slow of the normal rate (shield.slowed); flashTime the disc's bright flash; parryNextLead the watch helper's lead time. charge (GAME-05) is press dash while raised at the locked Foamer (chargeTarget, nearest in coneDeg and range, in sight): the player is driven at it at speed m/s for at most time s through the player's own character controller, stops stopShort m short, and on contact the Foamer is knocked knockback metres along the charge through its own controller, staggered and damaged by damage; kick the view kick in radians decaying over kickTime; cooldown before the next charge.

look._note: GAME-04c: the disc is built from concentric foam bands and a ring of rounded nubs on the rim edge, in the factory palette (CONTENT-PLAN 3.4). diameter and every length are metres, in camera space for the held disc. bands run outside in: radiusShare is the band's radius as a share of diameter/2, thicknessShare its thickness against rimThickness; domeDepth is how far the innermost band sits forward of the rim, so the disc reads as domed. nubCount nubs of nubRadius sit on the rim's edge: the foam saw's teeth, rounded. spinRevPerSec is the flying disc's spin about its own axis; it flies flat and edge first, its face up and tipped back toward the thrower by flightTiltDeg. The centre boss is a plain placeholder: the emblem is [Paul].

saw._note: GAME-04c: the foam saw. A thrown disc that strikes a Foamer lodges at the contact point and grinds it for grindSeconds: the disc stays at that point on the Foamer as it moves, spins at spinRevPerSec, carves a carveRadius sphere from the part it struck every tickSeconds, deals damagePerTick to the Foamer, sprays at most debrisPerTick chunks a tick and holds the Foamer staggered. plateShare is the tick's share against an armour plate (a dart does 0.15 there), so the saw is the Darter's counter. canKill false keeps the throw's rule: the saw never kills, it weakens a Foamer into the finishable band.
